summary: Built Relay's dbt semantic layer in relay_dbt/models/semantic/ (7 files, ./dbt parse and ./mf validate-configs both pass with 0 errors). Added 1 helper model (customer_months.sql: account x month grid with paying/prev-paying/churned/first-paying flags, built to marts.customer_months) and 11 semantic models over the marts with shared account/subscription/plan/invoice/rep entities so every metric slices by segment, region, country, currency, plan family, sales team and time. Defined 19 metrics: mrr (active+past_due, annual/12, month-end FX; Jun-25 $4.18M), arr, paying_customers, arpa, new_customers (first paying month), logo_churn, churn_rate (vs prior-month base), billings and recognized_revenue (issued invoices ex draft/void, net of tax), cash_collected (succeeded payments), refunds (all credit-note reasons), billable_usage (api_call only, heartbeat excluded), bookings/new_bookings/expansion_bookings (closed-won by close date) and win_rate, plus component metrics. Every model, entity, dimension, measure and metric carries an include/exclude description; internal and deleted accounts are excluded throughout. Verified all metric values and sliced queries against independent hand-written SQL with exact matches.
